title: Don’t Eat During Eclipse? Sadhguru Debunked
tags: can you eat during an eclipse
description:
During the recent solar eclipse, while people across India fasted and prayed, Sadhguru uploaded a video giving his trademark pseudoscientific advice — don’t eat during an eclipse or you’ll lose 27 days of your life. According to him, food “rots in your stomach,” cooked food is like a “dead body,” and somehow your body fast-forwards into rapid deterioration.

But the biggest blunder? In the middle of explaining the solar eclipse, he suddenly referred to a lunar eclipse instead — confusing the two phenomena entirely. From claiming the Moon moves faster on eclipse day, to cooked food equating to dead bodies, Sadhguru’s word salads are a masterclass in pseudoscience.

In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts exposes the absurdity of these claims, explains the real science of solar and lunar eclipses, and shows why there is zero harm in eating during an eclipse. Eclipses are celestial alignments, not cosmic punishments.

If you’ve searched for “Sadhguru eclipse blunder,” “Sadhguru eclipse boo boo,” “don’t eat during eclipse debunk,” “Sadhguru solar eclipse pseudoscience,” “lunar vs solar eclipse explained,” “why Sadhguru is wrong,” “pseudoscience in India eclipse,” or “science behind solar eclipses”, this video breaks down the comedy of errors. Like, share, and subscribe if you’d rather trust a 5th standard science teacher than a guru on a motorbike.
